judgments.yea_description: Voted to agree to the conference report on S.B. 56, which rewrote Ohio's marijuana laws into a single Marijuana Control Law, barred possession or use of marijuana not bought from a licensed Ohio dispensary or grown at the user's own home, and ended the state's authority to approve new forms of adult-use marijuana. It passed the Ohio House 52-34 and was signed into law.

It passed the Ohio House 52-34 and was signed into law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.B. 50, which would have let employers schedule 14- and 15-year-olds to work until 9 p.m. year-round with a parent's or guardian's written approval, loosening the work-hour limits for young teens during the school year. It passed the Ohio Senate 24-9 and was vetoed by the Governor.

It passed the Ohio Senate 24-9 and was vetoed by the Governor.
